verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI supports fine-grained tool control via function tools and deferred tools that require human approval before execution, plus an allowlisted shell in its coding-agent CLI — real guardrail primitives for an engineering lead. However there is no documented sandboxed execution environment (e.g., container/VM isolation) for tool calls. Missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/isolation mechanism, granular per-tool permission policies beyond approval gating, and independent verification of these safety features in production use.
